biography.plain_text: Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum is an Emirati royal and statesman born into Dubai’s Al Maktoum ruling family. Prepared for government from youth, he became head of Dubai Police in 1968 and the UAE’s first defence minister in 1971. He later helped steer Dubai’s growth through its airport, Jebel Ali Free Zone and the launch of Emirates airline, before succeeding his brother as ruler in 2006 and becoming UAE vice president and prime minister.
biography.html: Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum is an Emirati royal and statesman born into Dubai’s Al Maktoum ruling family. Prepared for government from youth, he became head of Dubai Police in 1968 and the UAE’s first defence minister in 1971. He later helped steer Dubai’s growth through its airport, Jebel Ali Free Zone and the launch of Emirates airline, before succeeding his brother as ruler in 2006 and becoming UAE vice president and prime minister.
